BiblicalUsage: Once, in the army of Jehoshaphat: next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour. The name is a captain who offered himself willingly, and the offering is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A captain named once for willing himself to the LORD carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the army of Jehoshaphat, that its captains are counted by their willingness as much as by their thousands.
